### Codes I left out on purpose
- **Family history:** 12C2-x, 12C3-x, 12C5, 12CA–12CD, 12CN, 12CP, ZV173-2.
- **Negative findings, suspected MI or admin codes:** 3231 (ECG: no MI), ZV719 (observation for suspected MI), and 9hM, 9hM0, 9hM1 (exception reporting).
- **Codes where no MI happened:** G3110 and G3110-1 (MI aborted), and G312 (coronary thrombosis not resulting in MI).
- **Related heart conditions that aren't MI:** G3115 (acute coronary syndrome), G311 (preinfarction syndrome), unstable angina, 14AW (H/O acute coronary syndrome), and 32E3 (ST elevation alone).
- **Procedure:** 790H0-98 (infarct myocardiectomy).

If you only want acute events, limit the list to the acute MI, subsequent MI, complications and postoperative sections. Use the history and ECG codes when you want to find anyone who has ever had an MI.

- **Codes that rule out MI:** 3231 (ECG: no MI), G3110 and G3110-1 (aborted MI) and G312 (coronary thrombosis not resulting in MI).
- **Unconfirmed or suspected MI:** ZV719 (observation for suspected MI), G311, G311z and G311-2 (preinfarction syndrome / impending infarction), unstable angina and acute coronary syndrome codes (G311x, G3115, G31y0-99) and 14AW (H/O acute coronary syndrome).
- **Admin codes:** 9hM, 9hM0 and 9hM1 (exception reporting for MI quality indicators).
- **Surgery:** 790H0-98 (infarct myocardiectomy).
- **Infarction of other organs:** for example stroke, lung and kidney infarction.

I searched CPRD by term and by Read code and found **69 codes that indicate myocardial infarction (MI)**. I counted acute, later, after-surgery, old/healed and history-of codes, since all of them mean the person has had an MI. A further 11 borderline codes are listed separately for you to decide on.

### Borderline codes (include if you want to catch more cases)

| Read code | Term | Reason |
|---|---|---|

- **Family history codes:** 12C5, 12C5-1, 12C2-1/-2, 12C3-1/-2, 12CA–12CD, 12CN, 12CP, ZV173-2. These are about relatives, not the patient.
- **Quality-indicator exception codes:** 9hM, 9hM0, 9hM1. These are administrative reporting codes.
- **Unstable angina and acute coronary syndrome codes** (G311x, G3115, G31y0-99, 14AW). These are heart conditions that are not MI.
- **790H0-98 Infarct myocardiectomy.** This is a surgical procedure code, not a diagnosis.

If you only want new MI events (for example, for an incidence study), keep only the acute, subsequent, complication and post-operative codes. Drop the history, old-MI and ECG codes.

| Read code | Term | Reason |

| G30A | Mural thrombosis | Sits under the acute MI code group but isn't itself an MI |
| G310 | Post-myocardial infarction syndrome | Implies an earlier MI |

| G501 | Post infarction pericarditis | Implies an earlier MI |

| G3110 / G3110-1 | Myocardial infarction aborted | ✗ Exclude (the MI did not happen) |
| G312 | Coronary thrombosis not resulting in myocardial infarction | ✗ Exclude |
| ZV719 | [V]Observation for suspected myocardial infarction | ✗ Exclude (suspected MI only) |

### Left out on purpose
- **Family history codes:** 12C5, 12C5-1, 12C2-1/-2, 12C3-1/-2, 12CA–12CD, 12CN, 12CP, ZV173-2. These are about relatives, not the patient.
- **Quality-indicator exception codes:** 9hM, 9hM0, 9hM1. These are administrative reporting codes.
- **Unstable angina and acute coronary syndrome codes** (G311x, G3115, G31y0-99, 14AW). These are heart conditions that are not MI.
- **790H0-98 Infarct myocardiectomy.** This is a surgical procedure code, not a diagnosis.

If you only want new MI events (for example, for an incidence study), keep only the acute, subsequent, complication and post-operative codes. Drop the history, old-MI and ECG codes.
